hero.description: Dar Al-Muqamah is an online learning platform that makes the Holy Quran, the Arabic language, and Islamic teachings accessible to learners worldwide, especially non-Arabic speakers.
hero.statsSubtitle: at Dar Al-Muqamah learning Quran & Arabic

aboutPreview.subtitle: About Our Academy
aboutPreview.desc1: Our academy is a specialized online educational platform striving to bring the beauty of the Holy Quran, the richness of the Arabic language, and the teachings of Islam to learners all around the globe.
aboutPreview.desc2: We provide a comprehensive, enjoyable educational experience tailored specifically for non-Arabic speakers, combining authentic Islamic scholarship with structured pedagogy and personal mentorship.

programs.title: Our Programs
programs.quranVerse: And whatever good you put forward for yourselves - you will find it with Allah. It is better and greater in reward.
programs.description: From your very first Arabic letter to confident Quran recitation and deeper understanding of Islam, our programs bring everything together in one place, specially tailored for non-Arabic speakers.

quran_memorization.title: Quran Memorization
quran_memorization.desc: Memorize the Holy Quran with dedicated instructors, personalized guidance, and a pace suited to every student.

quran_revision.title: Quran Revision
quran_revision.desc: Maintain the strength of what you have memorized through structured, consistent revision.

quran_recitation.title: Quran Recitation
quran_recitation.desc: Learn to read and recite the Holy Quran with accuracy, fluency, and confidence.

noor_albayan.title: Noor Al-Bayan (Foundations)
noor_albayan.desc: Build the foundation of Arabic reading, from letter recognition and accurate pronunciation to confident recitation.

tajweed.title: Tajweed Rules
tajweed.desc: Master the rules of Tajweed and apply them for a correct and melodious recitation.

arabic_language.title: Arabic Language
arabic_language.desc: Develop reading and communication skills in Modern Standard Arabic, understanding the language of the Quran.

islamic_studies.title: Islamic Studies
islamic_studies.desc: Build a comprehensive understanding of your faith alongside Quran and Arabic studies (Aqeedah, Fiqh, Hadith, Quranic and Prophets' Stories).

whyUs.intro: What makes our academy distinctive is our commitment to authentic Islamic education, tailored instruction, and a caring, encouraging student community.

comprehensive.title: 1. All-in-One Learning Hub
comprehensive.desc: From Quran memorization, recitation, and revision to Noor Al-Bayan, Tajweed, Arabic, and Islamic studies, we unite key areas in one cohesive experience.

nonArabic.title: 2. Tailored for Non-Arabic Speakers
nonArabic.desc: Our pedagogy directly addresses the specific challenges faced by non-native speakers, building skills step-by-step from letters to fluent recitation.

personalized.title: 3. Personalized 1-on-1 Progress
personalized.desc: No two students learn the same way. We focus on individual attention, customized pacing, and tailored mentorship for each student's goals.

teachers.title: 4. Qualified & Dedicated Teachers
teachers.desc: We value knowledgeable, patient, and encouraging instructors who foster both academic excellence and positive rapport.

fullExperience.title: 5. Complete Islamic Experience
fullExperience.desc: We go beyond recitation to teach Aqeedah, Fiqh, Hadith, and inspiring stories, giving students a well-rounded foundation in Islam.

flexible.title: 6. Flexible Global Online Learning
flexible.desc: Our online model allows learners worldwide to study from the comfort of home with schedules that easily fit busy family routines.

interactive.title: 7. Engaging & Fun Classes
interactive.desc: Learning Quran and Arabic is never a chore. We use vibrant visuals and interactive quizzes to create an enjoyable atmosphere where kids thrive.

parentsPartnership.title: 8. Active Parent Partnership
parentsPartnership.desc: Your child's learning is a collaborative journey. We keep parents continuously updated with progress notes and constructive feedback.

progressTracking.title: 9. Clear & Dedicated Progress Tracking
progressTracking.desc: No guessing your child's level. Structured daily reports and detailed monthly assessments give you a transparent view of fluency and growth.

progress.title: Progress You Can Clearly See
progress.desc: No guesswork needed. Our structured daily reports and in-depth monthly evaluations give you full visibility into your child's fluency, memorization, and overall achievements.

ctaSection.title: At Our Academy, Every Lesson is a Growth Opportunity
ctaSection.desc: Every achievement is celebrated, and every step brings the learner closer to the guidance of the Quran. Begin your journey today.

about.title: Dar Al-Muqamah Online
about.subtitle: A dedicated online platform bringing the beauty of the Quran and the richness of Arabic to learners worldwide.
about.whoAreWeP1: Our academy is a specialized online learning platform striving to connect learners across the globe with the beauty of the Holy Quran, the Arabic language, and Islam.
about.whoAreWeP2: We offer a rich, enjoyable learning experience designed specifically for non-Arabic speakers, bridging authentic knowledge with modern educational techniques.
about.whoAreWeP3: Our curriculum encompasses Quran memorization, recitation, revision, Noor Al-Bayan foundational reading, Modern Standard Arabic, Tajweed, and comprehensive Islamic studies.
about.whoAreWeP4: We believe every learner deserves a genuine connection to the Quran regardless of age or starting level. Our supportive tutors ensure steady, confident spiritual and academic growth.
about.whoAreWeP5: Dar Al-Muqamah is more than a school; it is a community for lifelong connection to the Quran and the Arabic language.
about.missionP1: Our mission is to make authentic Quranic and Islamic education easily accessible worldwide, empowering non-Arabic speakers to read with precision, fluency, and deep appreciation.
about.missionP2: We are dedicated to delivering top-tier personalized instruction combining accurate recitation with impactful Arabic and essential Islamic values.
about.missionP3: Through qualified educators, structured learning paths, and a nurturing environment, we nurture a genuine love of learning that lasts.
about.goalP1: Our core aim is to empower students worldwide to cultivate a confident, meaningful, and enduring relationship with the Book of Allah and the Arabic language.
about.goalP2: We guide every student from basic phonetics to fluent recitation with correct Tajweed, robust language understanding, and solid Islamic character.
about.goalP3: Our vision is to nurture a generation of learners who recite with confidence, understand the language of revelation, and carry Islamic virtues into everyday life.

testimonialsSection.subtitle: Parents & Students Feedback
testimonialsSection.titlePart1: What Our Students & Parents Say About
testimonialsSection.desc: Real feedback from families worldwide who trusted Dar Al-Muqamah to guide their Quranic and Arabic learning journey.

t1.name: Umm Abdulrahman
t1.comment: An exceptional experience with Dar Al-Muqamah. The instructors are remarkably patient with non-native children, and the monthly progress reports made a visible impact.

t2.name: Ahmed Farooq
t2.comment: I started from the very basics of Tajweed rules and now recite with confidence. Flexible schedules and clear explanations made learning enjoyable and seamless.

t3.name: Sarah Kamal
t3.comment: The Noor Al-Bayan and Arabic program is brilliantly designed for diaspora children. The personalized 1-on-1 attention keeps my daughter engaged and eager.
